exempt.NetworkCheck.DifftestMain: the difftest against certificate.py, under `runs`: compiled evaluation of NetworkCheck.Difftest.main, audited under NetworkCheck, a test and not a proof
exempt.NetworkCheck.Main: the network-check executable's entry point, one line; its command is Core.Protocol.main of NetworkCheck.Check.protocol, audited under NetworkCheck
exempt.NetworkCheck.PeriodMain: the network-period executable's entry point, one line; its command is Core.Protocol.main of NetworkCheck.Period.protocol, audited under NetworkCheck
exempt.NetworkCheck.RecordsMain: the network-records executable's entry point: Core.Protocol.main of NetworkCheck.Records.protocol, or Difftest.serve of its verdicts with the grid compared (verdicts) or not (verdicts-no-grid) of N2's link-window verdict of record (link-window, NetworkCheck.LinkWindow.linkWindowFn), of the client's check of a window's served certificates (certificates, NetworkCheck.LinkWindow.certificatesFn) and of the syncs the certifier signed for a link, read through its clock certificates' openings (clocks, NetworkCheck.Period.clocksFn), audited under NetworkCheck

NetworkCheck.DifftestMain.why: 2,000 random instances on which NetworkCheck.Certificate gives what verity/core/protocols/certifier/certificate.py gives, byte for byte: depth, E_0 … E_D, real_frames, frame_leaf, frames_root, open_frame, verify_frame on openings and tampered ones, parameters_digest and its canonical JSON, record_head and RecordHead's encoding and digest, certificate_digest (the record's digest under a 64-byte salt, and other lengths), certificate_message over the signed digest (with session ids of 32 bytes, and of 0, 31, 33 and 64, refused) and node, with each ValueError a refusal

NetworkCheck.Certificate.why: the encodings are code: Lean core, C-Flock's hashes, bytes and canonical JSON, and core's tagged SHA-512 only, no Mathlib and nothing of Security

NetworkCheck.Check.why: the check is code: the record's encodings, the certifier program's Program grid and Σ_sync, the LMS verifier and the core protocol interface, no Mathlib and nothing of Security

NetworkCheck.Period.why: the period's check is code: v4's certificate and sync decoders, the LMS verifier, the core interface with its integrity profile (to read one-stage's answers), C-Flock's program decoder (the scan's Program, whose templates give its terms), C-Flock's frame-v3 hash (the rows' domain) and the window record's digest, no Mathlib and nothing of Security; the period's check is code: v4's certificate and sync decoders, the LMS verifier, the core interface with its integrity profile (to read one-stage's answers), C-Flock's program decoder (the scan's Program, whose templates give its terms), C-Flock's frame-v3 hash (the rows' domain) and NCI's description-sized layout checks (the scan's layout read off its description), no Mathlib and nothing of Security

NetworkCheck.Records.why: the check over raw, committed and certified records is code: v2's check, and the difftest server's line protocol for its verdicts, no Mathlib and nothing of Security

NetworkCheck.LinkWindow.why: N2's link-window verdict of record is code: v4's certificate, its one LMS check and its encodings, the LMS verifier, C-Flock's hm96 row commitment, canonical JSON and frame-v3-sha512 domain, and core's identity hash, no Mathlib and nothing of Security

reads_exempt.Flock: C-Flock is excepted until its spec is extracted: the records check's evidence bridge reads C-Flock's `V`, JSON accessors and `unhex`, on both sides of its equation
